Monday – Friday: 9:30 AM – 7:00 PM
Practice Area
Private, faster resolution of commercial disputes.
Overview
We act as counsel in domestic and international commercial arbitrations, draft and stress-test arbitration clauses, and represent clients in Section 9 and Section 34 proceedings before the courts under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996.
Arbitration delivers speed and privacy when the clause is well drafted and the process is run tightly. It delivers neither when the clause is copied from an unrelated contract. We spend real time on the dispute resolution clause at the drafting stage, because that is where arbitration succeeds or fails.
Services Offered
Drafting and review of arbitration and dispute resolution clauses
Counsel in domestic and international commercial arbitration
Interim measures under Section 9 and Section 17
Challenge and enforcement of arbitral awards
Institutional and ad-hoc arbitrator appointment
Commercial mediation and conciliation
Our Process
Four stages, each with a defined output — so you always know what has happened and what comes next.
We confirm the seat, governing law, appointment mechanism and scope, and identify any defect that could be used to derail the reference.
We issue the notice of arbitration and manage constitution of the tribunal, including court applications where appointment stalls.
We prepare statements of claim or defence, documentary compilations and witness evidence, and argue the hearings.
We enforce a favourable award or defend it against challenge, and advise on setting aside where the award is unsustainable.
Benefits
These are commitments, not aspirations. If we fail one of them on your matter, tell the partner handling it.
Arbitration clauses drafted to work under pressure
Confidential process that keeps commercial disputes out of public record
Interim protection secured while the reference proceeds
Enforcement strategy planned before the award is delivered
Get In Touch
Tell us about your matter and we will respond within one working day. Every enquiry is confidential from the moment it reaches us.
Messages answered during office hours.
